title: TabFM-Auto: Self-Evolving Pipelines for Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.37989v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tabular foundation models achieve strong zero-shot accuracy on structured data by pretraining on synthetic tables, but they ignore the column names, task descriptions, and auxiliary files that carry dataset semantics. Meanwhile, self-evolving machine learning engineering (MLE) agents train models from scratch on each dataset, yet jointly searching over features, architectures, and hyperparameters is noisy and prone to overfitting. We introduce TabFM-Auto, which pairs a tabular foundation model, TabFM, with a language model agent that evolves the data pipeline around it. Guided by dataset metadata and validation feedback, TabFM-Auto iteratively refines data cleaning, feature engineering, context selection, and post-processing to reduce TabFM's error. translated_title: TabFM-Auto：面向表格基础模型的自进化流水线
translated_abstract: 表格基础模型通过在合成表格上进行预训练，在结构化数据上实现了强大的零样本准确率，但它们忽略了承载着数据集语义的列名、任务描述和辅助文件。与此同时，自进化的机器学习工程（MLE）智能体在每个数据集上从头开始训练模型，然而对特征、架构和超参数进行联合搜索的过程噪声大且容易过拟合。我们提出了TabFM-Auto，它将表格基础模型TabFM与一个围绕其演化数据流水线的语言模型智能体相结合。在数据集元数据和验证反馈的引导下，TabFM-Auto迭代地优化数据清洗、特征工程、上下文选择和后处理，以降低TabFM的误差。在TabArena基准的全部51个数据集上，五种采用不同智能体和语言模型的TabFM-Auto配置包揽了总排名前五位，其中最佳配置将TabFM的准确率从（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: TabFM-Auto将表格基础模型与语言模型智能体结合，通过迭代自进化数据流水线（数据清洗、特征工程、上下文选择和后处理），在TabArena基准的51个数据集上包揽总排名前五，显著提升了表格基础模型的性能。
en_tdlr: TabFM-Auto pairs a tabular foundation model with a language model agent that self-evolves the surrounding data pipeline (data cleaning, feature engineering, context selection, and post-processing), sweeping the top five positions across all 51 TabArena benchmark datasets and substantially improving the foundation model's accuracy.
